steps.headline: The favorite star sits right beside INSTALLED, and install counts show as a download arrow plus the number.
steps.changed: The star (or the download button for uninstalled items) moved out of the card's corner into the title row, next to the status pill. '412 installs' became ⬇ 412.
steps.notice: The title row is now [INSTALLED][★] for installed items and [⬇] for the rest; nothing floats over the card any more. Hover the number for the words.
steps.risk: Long titles truncate a few characters earlier because the row now holds two controls.

steps.headline: The author is a chip in the badge row — Likely safe · YouCoded · @destin — on cards and on the detail page.
